items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 63:1
items.html: The place for BYA was prepared at the time of the second restriction. For there the bottom Hey rose to the Einayim, and the AHP went outside the degree in RTS [Rosh-Toch-Sof], and the point of Sium that was in the Malchut of NHY was raised to the Malchut of Hochma of NHY, and the Bina and ZON of NHY went out below the Sium of the line of Ein Sof. By this they were separated from Atzilut and became a place for BYA of separation, from whose force those three worlds were afterwards corrected. (p. 463, Item 57)
